name: anim_slow_move_frames
description: MID-ANIMATION FRAMES of an engine-driven move. Removing #sidebar makes #card slide left; the animation is then stepped in exact 16.666 ms increments with a screenshot after each, so the intermediate transforms are captured rather than inferred. This is the visual counterpart to anim_dom_transition, which asserts the numbers: here the assertion is that the transform is DECREASING frame over frame and reaches identity, i.e. the card is actually travelling rather than jumping. Run with AZ_E2E_SHOT_DIR=/some/dir to also write the PNGs, which is how the sequence is eyeballed.
